content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: B.Sc. (Nursing) or Post Basic B.Sc. (Nursing) with integrated Curriculum of certificate program in Community Health (CPCH) from recognized nursing colleges with integrated curriculum passed in or after academic year 2016-2020. Age limit: 35 years for General, 37 years for OBC, 38 years for Female Unreserved, 40 years for ST/SC (as on 22 November 2026) Age relaxation: General 35, EWS 35, OBC (BC-I & BC-II) 37, Female Unreserved 38, ST/SC 40, PH General 45, PH EWS 45, PH OBC 47, PH Female Unreserved 48, PH ST/SC 50 Other conditions: Initial contract is for one year, renewable based on satisfactory performance and requirement. No claim for absorption in regular position shall be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for JRHMS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who furnish incorrect/false information or suppress material facts.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Fixed remuneration of Rs. 25,000 per month, plus performance-based incentive of maximum Rs. 15,000 per month as per guidelines. Contractual service for a period of one year under National Health Mission, Jharkhand. Can be terminated by either party with one month advance notice.

content_sections.heading: How Will JRHMS Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Online application submission Verification of documents and eligibility Selection as per NHM guidelines and eligibility criteria.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Profile Image (Candidates recent photograph) Candidate's Signature Image 10th Mark sheet and certificate Essential Qualification Documents Essential Experience Documents (if applicable) Caste Certificate (if required) PH Certificate (if applicable) Registration Certificate (if applicable)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JRHMS Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Visit the official website http://jrhms.jharkhand.gov.in or www.recruitment.jharkhand.gov.in. Fill out the Online Application Form (OAF) with mandatory information. Upload required documents including photograph, signature, mark sheets, certificates, caste certificate, and registration certificate. Ensure the application status shows 'Submitted Successfully' before the closing date. Apply on or before 22 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Only online applications are considered valid. Half-filled applications shall be treated as incomplete and rejected.
